#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and current date."""
from datetime import date
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612.0, 792.0  # US Letter


def pdf_escape(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def helvetica_width(text, font_size):
    return 0.5 * font_size * len(text)


def build_text_pdf(path, lines, page_count=1):
    """Build a simple PDF from raw content streams."""
    font_sizes = sorted(set(ln["size"] for ln in lines))
    kids = []
    content_refs = []
    page_refs = []
    final = {}
    final[1] = "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>"
    final[2] = "<< /Type /Pages /Kids ["
    next_num = 3
    font_map = {}
    for size in font_sizes:
        font_map[size] = next_num
        final[next_num] = ("<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold "
                           "/Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>")
        next_num += 1
    for _ in range(page_count):
        content_refs.append(next_num)
        next_num += 1
        page_refs.append(next_num)
        next_num += 1
    for p in range(page_count):
        kids.append(f"{page_refs[p]} 0 R")
    final[2] = "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [" + " ".join(kids) + f"] /Count {page_count} >>"

    streams = []
    for p in range(page_count):
        parts = ["BT"]
        for ln in lines:
            text = ln["text"]
            size = ln.get("size", 12)
            y = ln.get("y", PAGE_H - 100)
            center = ln.get("center", False)
            color = ln.get("color", (0, 0, 0))
            r, g, b = color
            if center:
                x = (PAGE_W - helvetica_width(text, size)) / 2.0
            else:
                x = ln.get("x", 72)
            parts.append(f"{r:.3f} {g:.3f} {b:.3f} rg")
            parts.append(f"/F{font_map[size]} {size:.1f} Tf")
            parts.append(f"1 0 0 1 {x:.2f} {y:.2f} Tm")
            parts.append(f"({pdf_escape(text)}) Tj")
        parts.append("ET")
        stream = "\n".join(parts)
        streams.append(stream)
        content_ref = content_refs[p]
        final[content_ref] = f"<< /Length {len(stream.encode('latin-1'))} >>"
        page_ref = page_refs[p]
        res_fonts = " ".join(f"/F{font_map[s]} {font_map[s]} 0 R" for s in font_sizes)
        final[page_ref] = (f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {PAGE_W} {PAGE_H}] "
                           f"/Resources << /Font << {res_fonts} >> >> /Contents {content_ref} 0 R >>")

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = {}
    for n in sorted(final.keys()):
        offsets[n] = len(out)
        out += f"{n} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1")
        out += final[n].encode("latin-1") + b"\n"
        out += b"endobj\n"
        if n in content_refs:
            idx = content_refs.index(n)
            out += b"stream\n"
            out += streams[idx].encode("latin-1") + b"\n"
            out += b"endstream\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    count = len(final) + 1
    out += f"xref\n0 {count}\n".encode("latin-1")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for n in sorted(final.keys()):
        out += f"{offsets[n]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")
    out += (f"trailer\n<< /Size {count} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
            .encode("latin-1"))
    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(bytes(out))
    print(f"Created {path} ({len(out)} bytes)")


def main():
    today = date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %-d, %Y")  # e.g. August 2, 2026

    # 1) Create a sample report body (report.pdf did not exist in the workspace)
    body_lines = [
        {"text": "Financial Summary", "size": 24, "y": PAGE_H - 100, "center": True},
        {"text": "This sample report was generated to demonstrate the cover page.",
         "size": 12, "y": PAGE_H - 160, "center": True},
        {"text": "Revenue: $1,250,000", "size": 14, "y": PAGE_H - 240, "center": True},
        {"text": "Expenses: $980,000", "size": 14, "y": PAGE_H - 280, "center": True},
        {"text": "Net Income: $270,000", "size": 14, "y": PAGE_H - 320, "center": True},
        {"text": "Prepared for demonstration purposes.", "size": 10, "y": 80,
         "center": True, "color": (0.4, 0.4, 0.4)},
    ]
    build_text_pdf("report_body.pdf", body_lines, page_count=2)

    # 2) Create the cover page
    cover_lines = [
        {"text": "Annual Financial Report", "size": 36, "y": PAGE_H - 380, "center": True},
        {"text": date_str, "size": 18, "y": PAGE_H - 440, "center": True,
         "color": (0.2, 0.2, 0.2)},
    ]
    build_text_pdf("cover_page.pdf", cover_lines, page_count=1)

    # 3) Merge: cover page first, then report body -> report.pdf
    writer = PdfWriter()
    for page in PdfReader("cover_page.pdf").pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    for page in PdfReader("report_body.pdf").pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    with open("report.pdf", "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    # Verify
    final_reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
    print(f"Final report.pdf has {len(final_reader.pages)} pages")
    print("Cover page text:", repr(final_reader.pages[0].extract_text()[:120]))
    print("Body page 1 text:", repr(final_reader.pages[1].extract_text()[:80]))
    print(f"Cover date used: {date_str}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
